# Photo booth strips

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/photo-booth/

Capture or upload moments and arrange them into a photo-booth strip. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Capture three photos or upload three images, choose a frame and download the finished strip.

## Limits and checks

Camera access starts only after you request it. You can use uploads instead, and stop the camera at any time.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
